description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework with native TypeScript, edge‑ready routing, built‑in security & observability – the Express‑style API you love, without the bloat.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.199‑daily bundles native TypeScript support, edge‑runtime compatibility (Cloudflare Workers, Bun, Deno) and zero‑dependency security/observability out of the box, delivering sub‑millisecond routing that outperforms Express and Fastify in real‑world benchmarks. The release is positioned as the go‑to framework for AI‑augmented, serverless, and edge‑first applications, tapping into 2026 trends like LLM‑backed APIs, WASM extensions, and cloud‑native observability.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese for its zero‑dependency footprint and built‑in TypeScript, eliminating package‑bloat and compile‑step headaches.
Performance‑focused teams love the sub‑millisecond routing and built‑in edge‑runtime support that consistently beats Express/Fastify in latency‑critical workloads.
The integrated security, observability, and AI‑ready hooks provide a frictionless developer experience, letting you ship cloud‑native services faster than ever.
